text.content: Osaka Night Experience – Tobita Shinchi Route
Tobita Shinchi Walking Course – Evening Plan
Arrive at Dobutsuen-mae Station around 20:00
Walk along the main Tobita Shinchi street starting from Matsushima shopping street side
Observe / select from window displays (typical session time 15–30 min)
Budget recommendation: ¥15,000–¥30,000 per visit depending on class
Safety & Practical Notes
Cash only, bring small bills
Photography strictly prohibited
Foreigners sometimes refused, try speaking basic Japanese
